cases.question: ¿Qué productos tuvieron salidas por venta y cuántas unidades en abril de 2026?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(im.quantity) AS cantidad FROM inventory_movement im JOIN product p ON p.id = im.product_id WHERE im.movement_type = 'Sale' AND im.moved_at >= DATE '2026-04-01' AND im.moved_at < DATE '2026-05-01' GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY cantidad DESC LIMIT 50

cases.question: ¿Qué cantidades se consumieron y produjeron en transformaciones durante abril de 2026?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT ti.item_type, SUM(ti.quantity) AS cantidad FROM transformation t JOIN transformation_item ti ON ti.transformation_id = t.id WHERE t.annulled = FALSE AND t.date >= DATE '2026-04-01' AND t.date < DATE '2026-05-01' GROUP BY ti.item_type ORDER BY ti.item_type LIMIT 50

cases.question: ¿Cuál fue el saldo neto por cuenta contable en abril de 2026?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT aa.code, aa.name, SUM(jed.debit) - SUM(jed.credit) AS saldo FROM journal_entry je JOIN journal_entry_detail jed ON jed.entry_id = je.id JOIN accounting_account aa ON aa.id = jed.account_id WHERE je.status = TRUE AND je.entry_date >= DATE '2026-04-01' AND je.entry_date < DATE '2026-05-01' GROUP BY aa.id, aa.code, aa.name ORDER BY aa.code LIMIT 50
cases.generated_sql: SELECT aa.code AS cuenta_codigo, aa.name AS cuenta_nombre, COALESCE(SUM(jed.debit), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(jed.credit), 0) AS saldo_neto FROM public.journal_entry AS je JOIN public.journal_entry_detail AS jed ON jed.entry_id = je.id JOIN public.accounting_account AS aa ON jed.account_id = aa.id WHERE (je.entry_date >= CAST('2026-04-01' AS DATE) AND je.entry_date < CAST('2026-05-01' AS DATE)) AND je.status = TRUE GROUP BY aa.code, aa.name ORDER BY cuenta_codigo LIMIT 50
